source.notes: arch-047 — composition-now WITH A RECORDED CAVEAT (sweep row-047). The update/read law is exactly U3.D decayed-delta with a certified external route trace and the product-key router is external by design (verified against lingua/sparse_delta_memory/layer.py @ 183e7df8). CAVEAT: the pinned router's tie policy is backend-dependent torch.topk (not R.PK HIGHEST_ADDRESS) and route weights use a scaled softmax; an exact R.PK claim additionally requires a highest-address tie realization. This row claims the update/read law + external route composition, NOT router tie-policy identity. Layer module: architectures/sdm_memory.py.

external_stages: product-key score projection + read/write score biases
params.route: product-key top-k per factor, combined top-k, address = idx1*half + idx2, sorted ascending (CAVEAT: torch.topk tie policy)

coverage.notes: Layer executes the typed K3 route→update→read graph (two sparse_route_generation + one sparse_state_mixer node) on the native tier with the external projections and explicit state lifecycle, in tests/test_architectures_sdm.py. The router tie-policy/scale identity vs R.PK (HIGHEST_ADDRESS, frozen SOFTMAX) is the sweep-recorded open question and is NOT claimed; key_weighted_decay=True variants and deployed configs with non-unit act scales are out of scope.
